in_sanskrit.name: अजेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ajesh is derived from the Sanskrit word अज (aj) which means 'unconquered, invincible'. The suffix -esh is of uncertain origin, but it may be derived from the Sanskrit suffix -isha (ishwara), which denotes 'lord, god'. Therefore, the name Ajesh could potentially mean 'Lord of the Unconquered' or 'Invincible Lord'.
